svg.text: XSuM as shipped (surrogate_official_m3w0_pfp, 2026-11-09): inputs, models, generated tables
one true neutrino interaction in, its reconstructed record out; tables are the XSuM cafpyana dataframes (mcnu, mcprim, mcdaught, slc, pfp)
INPUTS (detector-causal truth)
Final-state particle set [mcprim]
all post-FSI primaries, up to 32 tokens by KE
(0.45% of neutrinos lose their softest ones)
token: class (mu, e, p, n, pi+-, pi0, gamma, K+-,
K0, Lambda, Sigma, other), px, py, pz, KE
+ path lengths from the vertex along its direction
to the cathode, x/y wall, z wall
dropped: neutrinos, nuclei, Bertini pseudo-particle
80 summary features [mcnu, mcprim]
true vertex; distances to cathode and walls;
per species: multiplicity, summed / max KE, leading
p, cos(theta), pT; totals (charged mult., visible E,
EM energy, longitudinal momentum)
Truth not used as input
no Geant4 quantity (end points, lengths, mcdaught):
copied or used as diagnostic reference only
mode, CC/NC, W, Q2, E_nu, signal flags: labels only
MODELS (trained on the training files only)
Particle encoder (code m3; trained first, then frozen)
transformer, 4 layers, d = 128, over particle tokens + a context
token (80 summary features) -> 64-d embedding z; trained on topology,
presence / containment flags and the slice block (3 M slices)
Slice generator, step 1: what exists (code m2)
input 80 features + z; matched slices per neutrino 0 / 1 / 2+: GBDT
topology: softmax MLP over 121 classes of
(n_pfp, n_prong, n_trk, n_proton, n_shower), sampled first
GBDT heads: second track, two-track block, charge in 1-4 cm
spheres, muon / pion-candidate containment flags,
point masses (vertex at walls, back-to-back pairs)
Slice generator, step 2: slice values (~50 numbers)
conditional flow matching, MLP 6 x 1024, masked per event to
the groups that exist; conditioned on features, z, topology
PFP generator: the PFP set of each slice (code m4)
softmax heads: number of fitted / unfitted PFPs; masked set flow
(transformer, d = 256, 4 layers, no particle attention) over up to
12 PFP tokens x 38 fields, incl. end displacement and per-axis
wall flag + offset; conditioned on features, z, topology, slice block
SURROGATED DATAFRAMES (production format)
slc_0: generated (slice generator)
vertex, nu_score, bcfm_score, total_pe, PFP counts;
longest / second track direction, length, PID, chi2;
two-track block (reco_t, opening angle, momenta, 12 end
points, containment); charge in 1-4 cm spheres
pass_* flags recomputed from the generated values;
tmatch_idx = generating neutrino, tmatch_eff / purity NaN
pfp_0: generated (PFP generator)
fitted PFPs only: trackScore, dist_to_vertex, primary flag,
track start, direction, end, length, range / MCS p_mu,
chi2 mu, p (2 calibrations), K, pi, PIDA (collection plane),
shower energy, length, angle, density, gap, dE/dx, start
track end generated; wall-flagged ends snapped onto the TPC wall
copied from the production
mcnu, mcprim, mcdaught, hdr, POT tables
not in the surrogated files
cosmic-only slices and slices not matched to a neutrino
PFPs without a track or shower fit
induction-plane chi2, PFP truth-match columns
Validation done (held-out test files)
per-column / per-field marginals (W1), group presence and containment heads, cohpi cut flow (all and true-signal),
correlation matrices and joint densities, per-event real-vs-generated correlations on the same neutrinos,
CC1p0pi acceptance (two signal definitions, jobs 0-199), containment diagnostic, track-end floor, hybrid real-slice test
not done yet: physics holdouts, uncertainty estimates; CC1p0pi purity gap in the slice generator (studies: slice_generator_proposal.svg)
Downstream (collaborators)
analyses run unchanged on the surrogated dataframes
and compare with the real chain on the test files:
cohpi (S. Oh), kaon (T. Wester), CC1p0pi (M. Fernandez)
test-file loader: dataframe/xsum_testsplit.py
Training data and datasets (truth and reco linked by tmatch_idx)
SBND 2026 gen2 BNB + cosmics CV, v10_14_02_03: official SAM definition, 749,262 flat CAFs, 9.94 M events, processed as 2,000 grid jobs
by a selection-free cafpyana configuration: 17.9 M true neutrinos, 5.74 M truth-matched slices. Split 80 / 10 / 10 by input file (never by row).
Slice and PFP generators trained on 3 M sampled training slices each (RTX 3090). Generated for all neutrinos: 5.92 M slices, 14.06 M PFPs.
Datasets: /pnfs/sbnd/persistent/users/lwan/dataframe/surrogate_official_m3w0_pfp/ (jobs 0-199 so far), surrogate_official_m3_pfp/ (2,000 files, previous PFP generator).
Shipped runs: encoder m3 (v1 inputs); slice generator m2_official_m3; PFP generator m4_official_m3w0 (generated track ends, wall flag, no particle attention).
